source_refs.title: Get directions in Google Maps
source_refs.verified_excerpt: On your Android phone or tablet, open the Google Maps app
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android phone or tablet: 1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Google Maps app. 2. Search for your destination, or tap it on the map. 3. In the bottom-left corner, tap 'Directions'. 4. Choose a travel mode: tap 'Driving' for driving directions, 'Transit' for transit, 'Walking' for walking, 'Ride' for rideshare or taxi, 'Cycle' for bicycle, or 'Motorcycle' for motorcycle directions.

source_refs.title: Get directions in Google Maps
source_refs.verified_excerpt: On your iPhone or iPad, open the Google Maps app
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone or iPad: 1. On your iPhone or iPad, open the Google Maps app. 2. Enter a place name or select a spot on the map to set your destination. 3. In the bottom-left corner, select 'Directions'. 4. Choose a travel mode: 'Driving', 'Transit', 'Walking', 'Ride', 'Cycle', 'Flight', or 'Motorcycle'.

source_refs.title: Get directions in Google Maps
source_refs.verified_excerpt: On your computer, open Google Maps
source_refs.model_visible_text: On computer: 1. On your computer, open Google Maps. 2. Click 'Directions'. 3. Set your start and end points by clicking the map, typing an address, or entering a place name. 4. Choose your travel mode: 'Driving', 'Transit', 'Walking', 'Cycle', or 'Flight'.

source_refs.title: Send directions to your phone or tablet
source_refs.section: Send directions to your phone or tablet
source_refs.applicability: Computer; directions with a single destination
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To send directions to your phone or tablet, you can't have multiple destinations.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On computer: To send directions to your phone or tablet, you can't have multiple destinations. 1. On your computer, open Google Maps. 2. Click 'Directions'. 3. Enter your desired locations. 4. Choose a route. 5. Click 'Send to phone'. 6. Select the device or email that you'd like to send the directions to.
